How to input in Odoo a Custom Color MAX order for a dealer order?

When a dealer wants to order a custom color you can either tell the dealer to order it directly in the B2B portal or you can do the order for them in Odoo. Let’s see both procedures.

Chapter 1 – Add the order for the client in odoo

If you want to add the order for the client:
1
Go to Sales App > New
2
Add the Client Name in the quotation

If you the client is setup correctly in Odoo its pricelist and the fiscal position should be automatically added to the order. In the below example the client had the pricelist set as Ahooga PRO – Germany therefore the order was updated with this pricelist.

3
Add the product, pay attention to find the one with “(custom color)” in brackets!
4
Add shipping!
5
Choose the Shipping Method:

Shipping NON Benelux for Outside BELGIUM but in EU

6
Confirm the order!
Note: if you want to be more specific you can click “other info” and add the reference name of the final client who chose the custom color and also the delivery requested date. You need to do this before confirming.

Chapter 2 – The dealer adds the bike in B2B portal

7
Dealer look for the Bike they need and they click on the custom color option.
8
Color and finishing selection then click “add to cart”
9
Continue towards checkout
10
Edit if needed the address, choose shipping method and then click CONFIRM
11
Because of Odoo, to confirm the order Dealers always need to select payment method – but you can tell them that they do not have to proceed with payment because we always have the 30 days payment terms agreement – (unfortunately Odoo does not understand this in the webshop but you can say to your clients that they are not obliged to pay immediately for B2B portal orders)
⚠️ DEALERS NEED TO SELECT “WIRE TRANSFER” and click “PAY NOW”.
